name: Blocky Surface Extraction
definition: A surface extraction method that generates a blocky (voxel-aligned) triangle mesh by iterating over voxels inside the isosurface and adding faces to the exterior boundary where adjacent voxels are outside the shape.
summary: Blocky Surface Extraction generates a voxel-aligned triangle mesh by constructing explicit quad faces from voxel corners, producing a strictly axis-aligned aesthetic that differs from Boolean Voxel Meshing.
